name: parachute-recool-pitch
description: 180-second editorial Remotion film for Parachute ReCool

scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts --port 3000
scripts.check:final: npm run assets && npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-editorial.mjs
scripts.compositions: npm run assets && remotion compositions src/index.ts
scripts.render:final: npm run check:final && remotion render src/index.ts ParachuteReCoolFinal out/parachute-recool-final.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=4
